title: Saying Goodbye Politely
paragraphs: The engagement gathering is slowly finishing, and most of the guests have already left. Yusuf wants to head home too, since he has an early meeting tomorrow, but he does not want to leave without a proper word.
He walks over to find his host near the kitchen. "Thank you so much for having me tonight. I need to head home now," he says with a warm and genuine smile on his face.

"You are always welcome here, anytime," the host replies kindly, shaking his hand. Yusuf says salam one last time before stepping out into the cool evening air, feeling grateful for the warm hospitality he received.

On the drive home, Yusuf reflects on how a proper, unhurried goodbye leaves a much better impression than simply slipping away. In a close community, small gestures like this quietly strengthen every relationship over time.
